backgrounds.title: Campbell Lane Deepavali Festive Bazaar
backgrounds.description: Highlights the bustling sights, colors, and textures of a festive night market packed with traditional sweets, flowers, and handcrafted decor.
backgrounds.prompt: A vibrant, eye-level tracking view through the bustling Campbell Lane pedestrian bazaar during the peak of Deepavali evening celebrations. Canopies overhead are draped with glowing paper lanterns, glittering tinsel, and peacock feather ornaments. Stalls on both sides spill over with piles of aromatic jasmine flower strings, stacked pyramid boxes of traditional Indian sweets (mithai), and trays of painted clay diyas. A warm, ambient, festive bokeh surrounds market-goers browsing through racks of embroidered textiles.

backgrounds.title: Shophouse Glow: Quiet Festivities of Dunlop Street
backgrounds.description: Highlights the quieter, atmospheric heritage charm of traditional shophouses adorned for the festival away from the main thoroughfare.
backgrounds.prompt: Prompt: A cinematic mid-distance street shot at twilight along Dunlop Street, showcasing two-story heritage shophouses with pastel-painted louvered shutters and ornate plaster reliefs. Traditional brass oil lamps and strings of warm lights adorn the five-foot ways, casting a cozy reflection onto wet cobblestone pavements after a brief evening shower. Small groups of residents and visitors sit outside open-fronted cafes and textile shops, surrounded by the subtle glow of festival paper lanterns swaying in the gentle breeze.

backgrounds.title: Radiant Little India: Deepavali Street of Lights
backgrounds.description: Captures the lively spirit and intricate light installations of Little India, showcasing the radiant heritage streets celebrating the Festival of Lights.
backgrounds.prompt: A cinematic, wide eye-level shot at dusk looking down Serangoon Road during the Deepavali festival. Elaborate, towering arches of golden, purple, and magenta light canopies stretch overhead, casting a warm, celebratory glow onto the bustling street below. Intricate glowing motifs of peacocks, lotus blossoms, and traditional clay oil lamps (diyas) illuminate the historic shophouse facades. Crowds of visitors dressed in vibrant festive attire stroll along the sidewalks, with streaks of vehicle tail lights blurring along the asphalt under the brilliant canopy of festive illuminations.

backgrounds.title: Marigold Toran Arch
backgrounds.description: Focuses on the lush texture of fresh marigold floral installations paired with delicate micro-LEDs across a grand traditional entrance.
backgrounds.prompt: A straight-on, medium-distance architectural shot framing a massive stone entrance archway decorated for the festival. The entire stone facade is enveloped in dense, cascading curtains of vibrant orange and golden-yellow marigold flowers intertwined with tiny, warm-white fairy lights. Flanking the heavy brass-studded wooden doors are two towering multi-tiered brass standing lamps, each tier holding a ring of glowing wicks. The smooth stone threshold below is clean and polished, catching the golden spill of the festive lights. Intricate floral density, balanced lighting, completely empty of people.

clothes.title: Structured Trench Kurta & Banarasi Trousers
clothes.description: Reinterprets traditional royalty through a sharp, tailored trench silhouette that opens to show off opulent brocade trousers beneath.
clothes.prompt: Prompt: A fashion-forward festive fusion look combining a tailored floor-length trench-style kurta with slim-cut trousers. The outer coat-kurta is crafted from rich cobalt-blue raw silk, featuring a sharp standing bandhgala collar, structured padded shoulders, and full-length straight sleeves. An asymmetric, double-breasted overlap is fastened with ornate filigree brass buttons. The lower half of the coat splits into dramatic, high-slit panels lined with contrast saffron silk, revealing tailored ankle-length cigarette pants made from heavy Banarasi brocade woven with intricate golden marigold motifs. A broad, laser-cut metallic belt cinches the waist firmly over the structured coat.

clothes.title: Solar Eclipse: Sculptural Cape & Pleated Dhoti Set
clothes.description: Merges structured modern tailoring with traditional draping, featuring a flowing one-shoulder cape paired with pleated dhoti pants.
clothes.prompt: Prompt: A dynamic, avant-garde festive Indo-western outfit in molten copper and rich jet black. The top piece is an architectural, structured asymmetric high-neck bodice with full-length fitted sleeves, connected to a long, sweeping floor-length cape that billows from one shoulder. The cape is crafted from micro-pleated metallic tissue silk that catches the light in liquid gold and copper tones. Paired with sharply draped, tulip-style black silk dhoti trousers featuring crisp, cowl-like origami folds down to the tapered ankles. Intricate geometric wirework embroidery lines the cape’s collar and outer perimeter, contrasting sharp tailoring against sweeping, fluid drapes.

clothes.title: Architectural Saree Gown
clothes.description: Replaces traditional soft drapes with rigid, origami-style pleating and metallic-sheen silk, transforming the classic saree into a sculptural gown.
clothes.prompt: Prompt: A futuristic, high-fashion reinterpretation of the traditional saree in deep midnight indigo and holographic silver foil. The structured silhouette is crafted as a continuous gown with a high, sculpted mock-neck collar and full-length fitted sleeves that end in sharp diagonal cuffs over the knuckles. Across the bodice and descending diagonally to the hip are sharp, origami-inspired geometric folds that simulate a pleated pallu, transitioning into a dramatic, rigid trail that floats cleanly off the left shoulder down to the floor. The long skirt features crisp, vertical accordion micro-pleats that flare slightly at the floor-grazing hem, fully opaque and structured to maintain its shape while walking. Accents of gunmetal metallic piping outline each angular fold.

clothes.title: Full-Sleeve Kanjeevaram Saree
clothes.description: Highlights heritage South Indian craftsmanship through pure mulberry silk, pairing elaborate temple-border weaving with a structured, long-sleeved silhouette.
clothes.prompt: Prompt: A traditional South Indian Kanjeevaram silk saree in deep vermilion red, paired with a matching tailored full-sleeve blouse. The blouse is designed with a high boat neckline, full-length opaque silk sleeves reaching the wrists with gold temple-patterned borders, and a high-cut back. The heavy silk saree features woven miniature gold peacocks across the body, with a wide, opulent pallu draped securely across the front torso in classic Nivi pleats and pinned neatly at the shoulder. The fabric displays a heavy, lustrous sheen of authentic mulberry silk, falling gracefully to cover the ankles.

clothes.title: Layered Brocade Angrakha Sherwani
clothes.description: Features historic royal crossover tailoring with an asymmetric front wrap, paired with a heavy contrasting stole and woven Banarasi motifs.
clothes.prompt: Prompt: A dynamic, full-length festive menswear ensemble in warm ochre, burnt amber, and antique gold. The knee-length angrakha sherwani is tailored from heavy Banarasi brocade featuring subtle self-weave paisley motifs. It features an asymmetric, overlapping diagonal chest closure tied at the right torso with braided golden silk cords and heavy metallic bell-tassels. Underneath, a straight-cut raw silk under-kurta extends an inch past the coat hem. Draped over the left shoulder is a broad, gathered silk organza stole (doshala) in deep crimson, edged with dense zardozi gold bullion fringes. The look is completed with tailored ivory silk trousers that drape straight down to the instep. Rich fabric weight, sharp folds, and tactile weaving.

clothes.title: Imperial Velvet Bandhgala
clothes.description: A classic regal ensemble combining architectural military-inspired tailoring with luxurious velvet and delicate gold accents for formal evening celebrations.
clothes.prompt: Prompt: A sharp, full-length portrait of a male festive Jodhpuri bandhgala suit in rich midnight navy velvet. The structured jacket features a stiff mandarin standing collar, structured padded shoulders, and tailored full-length sleeves finished with matte brass crested buttons at the cuffs. A diagonal placket is fastened with five ornate carved antique-gold buttons down the chest, complemented by a neatly folded ivory silk pocket square in the welt breast pocket. Delicate gold zari wirework outlines the outer rim of the collar and shoulder epaulets. The jacket is paired with tapered, fitted churidar trousers in ivory raw silk, tailored snugly around the calves and ankles. High-end menswear tailoring, crisp structural lines, and rich light-catching velvet texture.

clothes.title: Ivory Raw Silk Kurta & Kasavu Veshti
clothes.description: Highlights heritage South Indian festival tradition through unstitched draping, natural raw tussar silk, and authentic gold temple borders.
clothes.prompt: Prompt: A traditional South Indian festive menswear set in rich ivory and molten gold. The upper piece is a knee-length, straight-cut kurta crafted from raw tussar silk with a natural slub texture, featuring a modest band collar and full-length cuffed sleeves with small brass loop buttons. Draped on the lower half is a traditional handwoven cream cotton-silk veshti (dhoti), wrapped securely around the waist with crisp, vertical accordion pleats running down the front center. The veshti is bordered by a wide, three-inch metallic gold zari border (kasavu) that gleams along the bottom hem and side fold. Folded over the right shoulder is a matching silk angavastram shawl featuring identical gold temple borders. Organic fabric sheen, crisp pressed pleats, and authentic heritage simplicity.

clothes.title: Split-Cape Kurti & Swirling Dhoti
clothes.description: Features a dramatic split-back floating cape and deep, spiraling dhoti drapes that create bold, sweeping silhouettes in motion.
clothes.prompt: Prompt: A dynamic, fashion-forward festive set in vivid imperial purple and antique pewter. The focal piece is a knee-length, high-neck tunic crafted from structured silk jacquard with full-length fitted sleeves. Draped across both shoulders is a sweeping, floor-length split cape made of crisp, metallic-threaded organza that divides down the center back, billowing dramatically outward like wings with movement. Below, the bottom piece is a hybrid dhoti-skirt featuring voluminous, spiraling cowls of fluid modal satin that wrap around the legs in sweeping concentric folds down to the structured ankle bands. Delicate pewter wire embroidery tracing geometric peacock feather fractals details the mandarin collar and the outer edges of the split cape.
